title: Game update: Testing new PvP mode with my friend
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
Added multiplayer mode to my wizard fighting game and some more lighting effects to get a full day and night cycle. This is a clip from dusk 

The AI has added a multiplayer lobby, team selector and match rulesets and hitboxes to the characters as well
